purpose: Frozen reference point for the currently-working, no-lookahead Policy/Value online adapter (Combat/policy_agent.py) before Choice Semantics integration work begins. Does not move, copy, or overwrite any existing checkpoint or evaluation output - this file only records paths + hashes + a summary of what is already true.
rl_repo_note: C:\STS2_RL is not a git repository (no commit hash available here) - see harness_code_provenance below for the one Combat-side code change this baseline depends on.

checkpoints.encoder_note: sts2_training/encoding.py::ExportEncoder has no separate explicit version field; dictionary_version=v1 (above) plus state_dim=4560/action_numeric_dim=7 serve as its practical fingerprint. Both checkpoints embed identical id_dictionaries content, verified at load time by sts2_training/inference.py's PolicyDecision/ValueDetermination constructors.

emulator.version_gap_note: 0d16130 is 163bf04 + 2 commits (12df954, 0d16130) that add choice_card/choice_skip/choice_confirm choice-context fields (operation/source/origin) to LegalActions.Parameters and pendingChoice. No pre-existing observation/legal_action keys were changed or removed, and choice_* decisions are structurally routed to Heuristic fallback regardless of Policy - so this version gap does not affect Policy/Value's own input/output shapes. See rl_policy_online_eval_initial_report_20260724.md section 1.

execution_conditions.action_routing: card/potion/system -> PolicyDecision; choice_card/choice_skip/choice_confirm (and any other non-standard action_type) -> HeuristicAgent fallback, unconditionally, independent of confidence or lookup outcomes
execution_conditions.value_usage: scored and logged every decision; never used to select or override an action
execution_conditions.low_confidence_handling: flagged in logs (confidence < threshold, default 0.5); action selection unchanged
execution_conditions.any_enemy_targeting: first-alive (target_index=0) when 2+ enemies are alive and Policy's legal_actions carry no resolved target - no extra apply_action-based search; flagged as target_ambiguous in logs

harness_code_provenance.fix: emulator_bridge.py::to_plain() now converts System.Decimal (orb basePassiveValue/baseEvokeValue) to a plain Python float instead of leaving a live CLR object in engine_state - BattleEmulator.clone_state()/with_shuffle_seed() could not copy.deepcopy() such a value ('cannot pickle Decimal object'). Combat-side only - C:\STS2_Emulator and Training/ were not modified.
